name: Waydev
long_description: Waydev maps AI velocity across the SDLC — built on DORA, SPACE, and DX — turning developer tool data into board-ready evidence of adoption, impact, and ROI.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: I started my entrepreneurial journey early, building my first company in Romania at 21. Over the next decade I launched multiple products and learned how hard it is for engineering teams to explain the value they create. The idea for Waydev came from firsthand frustration while trying to understand developer output beyond gut feelings and subjective dashboards. There was no clear way to measure engineering performance using system data, so I decided to build it myself.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: I applied to YC because I believed Waydev could become a category defining product and I wanted to sharpen our execution with the best early stage accelerator in the world. It wasn’t an easy path. I applied 13 times before being accepted, and each rejection forced me to refine the idea, tighten the pitch, and improve the product. When we finally joined YC, the experience was transformative. The batch pushed us to move faster, simplify our messaging, and talk to customers every day. Demo Day helped us raise capital and accelerate our trajectory. More importantly, YC gave us a mindset of relentless iteration that still defines how we operate.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: YC has remained a core part of our company. I’m active in Bookface, talking to other founders about growth, engineering metrics, and the future of AI driven development. Many of our customers and partners come through YC referrals. We share learnings with other B2B and infra founders, and we rely on YC’s internal forums, templates, and tools for fundraising, hiring, and pricing decisions. YC helped us get started, but the community is what continues to compound our progress.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Waydev started as a simple tool to analyze Git activity. The product evolved quickly as customers pushed us toward deeper insights and enterprise scale. Key moments included securing our first Fortune 500 customers, launching integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, and building out enterprise features like SSO, RBAC, and advanced reporting.

A major inflection point came when we recognized that engineering intelligence needed an AI native interface. This led to the launch of Waydev AI, our conversational layer that lets leaders ask questions and get insights instantly without dashboards. Today, we support both large enterprises and fast growing teams, and we continue to integrate AI deeply into how engineering work is analyzed and measured.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Engineering is the most expensive function in modern companies, but historically it has been the hardest to measure. Leaders rely on anecdotal feedback, siloed dashboards, or lagging indicators that fail to capture the full picture of productivity, quality, and delivery. This lack of visibility leads to poor decisions, misalignment, reactive planning, and inefficient budgets.

We solve this by giving teams a unified intelligence layer that turns system data into clear, actionable insights. The problem is huge because every company depends on software, and engineering performance directly affects speed, cost, and competitiveness. I decided to work on this because I experienced the pain myself as a founder and saw thousands of teams navigating the same challenge.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long term vision is to build the intelligence engine behind every engineering organization. If we succeed, companies will understand their engineering health as clearly as they understand revenue or churn. Leaders will make better decisions, teams will work in a more predictable and balanced way, and engineering will become a transparent, measurable, and optimized function. In the future we imagine, every company will be able to ask one question, “What is happening in engineering and what should we do next?” and Waydev will deliver the answer instantly.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I'm Alex Circei, co-founder and CEO of Waydev (YC W21). I started my first company in Romania at 21 and have spent 18+ years building startups. In 2017 I launched Waydev, defining the Software Engineering Intelligence category — bootstrapped to profitability, recognized by Gartner and G2, and trusted by Fortune 500 teams at American Express, Caterpillar, Dropbox, and PwC.

launches.title: Waydev AI: The ChatGPT for Engineering Intelligence
launches.tagline: The first AI-native conversational platform that helps engineering leaders measure performance, track AI adoption, and understand how AI impacts delivery.
launches.body:
Hey, we’re Waydev, and we’re launching Waydev AI on YC and [ProductHunt.](https://www.producthunt.com/products/waydev?launch=waydev-ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94663&key=user_uploads/22643/9cf132dd-67ec-4ece-bed1-d5c53f6c5981)

### https://youtu.be/0Pz5mRiLpzE?si=rIQV4WzzaGLLB31M

### Problem

Engineering leaders struggle to understand performance, delivery, and the real impact of AI across their teams. Traditional engineering intelligence tools require endless dashboard setup, data interpretation, and manual correlation between GitHub, Jira, and other sources.

These legacy platforms were never built for the AI era - making it hard to measure AI adoption, productivity, and team impact in a way that feels natural or conversational. Even newer tools are bolting on “AI features” rather than rethinking the experience from the ground up.

### Solution

We built **Waydev AI**, the first **AI-native conversational platform for Engineering Intelligence**, designed so leaders can stop analyzing dashboards and start asking questions.

Waydev AI transforms how engineering teams understand performance and delivery. Just connect your tools - GitHub, Jira, Cursor, and more—and start asking in plain English:

* “What’s our AI adoption rate this quarter?”
* “Which teams improved their cycle time the most?”
* “How has AI impacted our delivery and bug rates?”

#### Key Features

💬 **Conversational Interface:** Chat directly with your data instead of digging through dashboards.\
🤖 **AI-Native Insights:** Instantly generate reports, visual charts, and performance breakdowns from natural-language questions.\
🔌 **Connect Your Stack:** Integrate GitHub, Jira, Cursor, and more in seconds.\
📈 **Dynamic Reports:** Save and share real-time insights that update automatically as your teams ship.\
🔍 **AI Adoption Metrics:** Track how generative AI tools like Copilot or Cursor are influencing developer productivity.

### Our Asks

🎯 Try **Waydev AI** today! Sign up at [waydev.co/ai](https://waydev.co/ai) and start asking your data.\
🚀 Support our [Product Hunt launch on October 15, 2025](https://www.producthunt.com/products/waydev?launch=waydev-ai)\
💼 We’re hiring engineers and AI researchers passionate about transforming the future of Software Engineering Intelligence.
